newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA JEWELLERY IN Q1 57,275 LATS LOSS.
newsitem.headline: RIGA JEWELLERY IN Q1 57,275 LATS LOSS.

text.p: Riga Jewellery plant's first quarter loss was 529,588 lats on net turnover of 57,275 lats, the bourse said on Thursday.
The bourse said it will start quoting the factory on its secondary list on June 16.
The company had production costs of 111,265 lats which lead to gross loss of 53,990 lats. It also registered 472,327 lats of extrordinary losses, the bourse said.
The company's balance sheet total at the end of march was 3.33 million lats and it had short-term debts of 417,921 lats.
It also had 2.66 million lats in stocks and 341,949 lats of payment due. The jewellery factory's basic capital is 3.39 million lats and it has reserves of 103,411 lats.
